verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax does calculate VAT/GST across many countries and provides registration monitoring plus a Dashboard/API for registrations and even offers to register on your behalf (docs-2,7,14,17,21), but filing automation is documented only for US sales tax via TaxJar (docs-10) — no evidence of automated EU/UK/Canada/Australia filing. Community hands-on reports explicitly contradict the 'covered like US tax' framing: 'If you're selling internationally it's woefully incomplete, so often not that useful' and 'vastly outgunned by its competitors' (comm-11, comm-12), and another user notes you still must remit/file yourself for non-US jurisdictions (comm-13). missing for 10: evidence of automated non-US VAT/GST filing, independent confirmation that international coverage matches US-level completeness, and rebuttal to the 'incomplete internationally' community reports.
